data.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion
data.detailed_description:
A classic PSX racing experience with a cast of anthropomorphic characters where you race through a rural setting of a very different America.  This classic arcade racing experience is the perfect blend of classic style and modern touches!

Join a small group of friends as they drive across the little region of Union County.  Competing against one another to see just who is the best racer, and who has the best ride.  Listen to the engines roar and those tires screech as they race though the streets of small towns, farms, back roads, and so more!  Just be careful, the local officials and police will do nearly anything to maintain the order they have there.

A Strange World and Stranger Tracks

Race through the town of Annabelle and the surrounding region of Union County.  A strange and isolated little place in rural Illois, one of the 54 United States of America.  The local authorities do everything they can to stop you, but that has not stopped these street racers from having fun!  Race through tracks carved out of old farm fields.  Tear down winding and twisting back roads.  Drive through areas that even the locals long since forgotten.  And if you are daring enough, let your engines scream as you race through the quiet streets of small towns in an act of open rebellion against the corrupt local order.

A Roster Full of Unique Characters!

Choose from a roster of racers who all bring something different to the table!  With six playable characters at the start and even more for you to unlock!  You are sure to find a character who fits your style of racing.  Do you like raw speed?  Maybe you like to play a little dirty and find all the shortcuts you can?  Maybe you love rides that can handle like a dream?  Or maybe you just like cars that are outright strange?  Total Shift has a character and a car for you!  Every racer in the cast plays differently and has different stats.

Race for Glory, Race for Fun, and Race for Something More…

Compete against other characters in challenges unique to each of them.  Pushing your skills and track knowledge to its limits to beat your competition.  Learn more about the world and characters as you play and conquer the challenges of the game!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or Intel Core i3-10100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 or Intel Core i3-12100F
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1080
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
